ei.title: Tuning Out: The Science of Noise-Cancellation / The Journey of Sound Waves

fullPassage:
Tuning Out: The Science of Noise-Cancellation

Which is the better environment for studying: a noisy place or a quiet place? Rarely do people want to put up with a lot of noise because it can be unpleasant and distracting. Fortunately, scientists have invented noise-cancelling technology, which is now being used across various fields to reduce unwanted noise. What is the scientific principle behind this achievement? To understand this, let's examine how sound travels.

The Principle of Sound Waves and Interference
Sound is produced through vibrations that occur from a sound source, when the strings of a guitar are played, for instance. The vibrations of the sound source cause the air to vibrate and the sound to travel as waves, similar to the ripples created in a lake when you throw a stone. When these sound waves reach our ears, the brain interprets them as sound. Just as different ripples in water might overlap if you throw two stones, sound waves can also interfere with each other when they meet. There are two types of interference: constructive and destructive. Constructive interference occurs when the peaks of two waves overlap, resulting in a bigger wave and a louder sound. Destructive interference, on the other hand, occurs when a peak of one wave overlaps with a valley of another wave, so they cancel each other out and produce a quieter sound, or no sound at all.

The Science Behind Noise-Cancelling Headphones
Destructive interference is used in the noise-cancelling feature of headphones when we listen to music. Inside the headphones are microphones and noise-cancelling circuitry. The microphones pick up sounds from the outside, and the circuitry analyzes them to produce opposite sound waves. For example, if outside noise has a value of +1, the circuitry will generate an opposite noise of -1 and transmit it to the speakers. This cancels out the unwanted sound even in noisy surroundings, so you can hear the music sound clearly without turning up the volume. However, it is not easy to entirely eliminate external noise with this technology. To achieve full noise cancellation, the circuitry must convert the noise into digital data and instantly transmit the opposite sound to the speakers as soon as the noise reaches the microphones. Therefore, this noise-cancellation technology is effective for predictable sounds like those of car engines and subways that occur regularly or over a period of time. However, it's relatively less effective for inconsistent sounds such as those of people talking close to you.

Exploring the Technology and Its Applications
Noise-cancelling technology is not only used in music devices. Other fields also take advantage of this technology, such as ticket offices at tourist attractions which are often very noisy. Microphones are installed in ticket offices to detect external noise, and an opposite sound wave is generated and transmitted through a speaker, enabling the ticket agent to hear the customer's voice clearly. Another area in which this technology is used is drive-through fast-food restaurants and coffee shops. They use noise-cancelling headsets to improve communication between employees and customers by eliminating vehicle noise. These noise-cancelling headsets help drive-through employees take orders accurately. The same technology is also used for cars, whose audio systems generate waves to cancel out unpleasant sounds such as engine, wind, and road noise. Thanks to noise-cancelling devices, it is possible for drivers to focus on driving without being disturbed by distracting noises.

As technology advances, many people expect it will solve various social issues caused by noise pollution. A common source of these problems is noisy neighbors, as the noise they make can lead to conflict among residents. Noise-cancellation technology can help address these problems by reducing unwanted disturbances, allowing people to lead more peaceful and healthier lives.

Deep Learning: The Journey of Sound Waves Through Our Ears
Have you ever wondered what happens to sound waves when they enter our ears? Let's take a closer look. The journey starts from the external part of the outer ear, which gathers the waves and directs them into the ear. The collected waves then travel through the ear canal and reach the eardrum located in the middle ear. When the eardrum vibrates, these vibrations are transmitted to three small bones in the middle ear. These bones make the vibrations stronger and then pass them to a snail-shaped structure in the inner ear. Inside this fluid-filled structure are tiny hair cells. When the vibrations make waves in the fluid, the tiny hair cells move and generate electrical signals that travel to the auditory nerve. This nerve carries the information to the brain, where the signals are interpreted, allowing us to hear sound. Undoubtedly, it is a quite remarkable journey!

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.tip: 주어-동사 수일치: 복수 주어 + 동사원형. waves → reach (not reaches).

det.analysis: ✅ ①used: be + p.p. 수동태. ✅ ②are: 도치 구문, 주어 microphones and circuitry(복수). ❌ ③it: 앞의 sounds(복수)를 받으므로 them이 되어야 함. ✅ ④clearly: 부사, hear를 수식.
det.tip: 대명사 수일치: 복수 명사 sounds → them. 도치: Inside the headphones are ~ (주어가 뒤에).

det.analysis: ✅ ①Rarely: 부정 부사 도치(Rarely do ~) 맞음. ❌ ②that: 콤마 뒤 계속적 용법에서는 which를 써야 함. that은 제한적 용법에만 가능. ✅ ③achievement: 명사, 문법적으로 맞음. ✅ ④examine: 동사원형, let's 뒤에 적절.

det.tip: detect(감지하다) = identify = find. 마이크의 기능 = 소리 감지.

questions.passage: The same technology is also used for cars, whose audio systems generate waves to cancel out ①<u>unpleasant</u> sounds such as engine, wind, and road noise. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 소음 제거 기술은 원치 않는 방해(disturbances)를 줄여 문제 해결에 도움을 준다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①unpleasant(불쾌한): 소음 묘사. 원문 그대로. ✅ ②possible(가능한): it is possible for ~. 원문 그대로. ✅ ③disturbed(방해받는): 소음에 방해. 원문 그대로. ❌ ④benefits(이점): 원문은 disturbances(방해). 줄이는 대상이 '이점'이면 맥락 불일치.
det.tip: disturbance(방해) ↔ benefit(이점). unwanted disturbances = 원치 않는 방해.

위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"유모세포가 만든 전기 신호는 청각 신경을 통해 뇌로 전달된다."

det.korean: 유모세포가 전기 신호를 생성하고, 이 신호가 청각 신경을 통해 뇌로 전달된다.
det.analysis: ✅ T: 원문 'generate electrical signals that travel to the auditory nerve. This nerve carries the information to the brain'과 일치.

questions.passage: Destructive interference is used in the noise-cancelling feature of headphones when we listen to music. Inside the headphones are microphones and noise-cancelling circuitry. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: +1과 -1이 합쳐져 원치 않는 소리를 상쇄시킨다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③cancels out: +1과 -1 → 상쇄. ❌ ①amplifies(증폭): 반대. ❌ ②records(녹음): 무관. ❌ ④picks up(감지): 마이크 기능이지 결과가 아님.
det.tip: cancel out = 상쇄시키다. +1 + (-1) = 0 → 소리 상쇄.

questions.passage: However, it is not easy to entirely eliminate external noise with this technology. To achieve full noise cancellation, the circuitry must convert the noise into digital data and instantly transmit the opposite sound to the speakers as soon as the noise reaches the microphones. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 기술은 예측 가능한 소리에는 효과적이지만, 가까이서 대화하는 사람들의 소리 같은 비일관적인 소리에는 상대적으로 덜 효과적이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②inconsistent sounds: However 대조 → predictable의 반대. ❌ ①regular patterns(규칙적 패턴): 앞 문장과 같은 의미. ❌ ③digital signals(디지털 신호): 무관. ❌ ④constructive waves(보강 파동): 맥락 불일치.
det.tip: However가 대조 단서. predictable ↔ inconsistent. 규칙적 소리 vs 불규칙적 소리.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 소음 제거 기술은 음악 기기에서만 사용된다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
ch: 외이의 바깥 부분이 음파를 모아 귀 안으로 보낸다.
모인 음파는 외이도를 통해 이동하여 고막에 도달한다.
고막의 진동은 내이의 달팽이관으로 직접 전달된다.
달팽이관 모양의 구조 안에는 작은 유모세포가 있다.

det.korean: 고막의 진동은 중이의 세 개의 작은 뼈를 거쳐 달팽이관으로 전달된다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③ 불일치: 고막 → 세 개의 뼈 → 달팽이관 순서인데, '직접 전달'이라 함. ❌ ① 일치. ❌ ② 일치. ❌ ④ 일치.

questions.stem: 다음 글에서 문법적으로 틀린 문장은?

det.korean: 기술이 발전함에 따라, 많은 사람들은 소음 공해에 의해 야기된 다양한 사회적 문제를 해결할 것으로 기대한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①정상: whose + 명사 + 동사. ✅ ②정상: it is possible for ~ to. ❌ ③causing → caused: issues와 수동 관계(야기된). caused by noise pollution. ✅ ④정상: by + V-ing.
det.tip: 과거분사 vs 현재분사: issues caused by ~(야기된) vs issues causing ~(야기하는). 문맥상 소음 공해가 문제를 야기하므로 caused by.

questions.passage: Have you ever wondered what happens to sound waves when they enter our ears? The journey starts from the external part of the outer ear, which gathers the waves and directs them into the ear. The collected waves then travel through the ear canal and reach the eardrum located in the middle ear. When the eardrum vibrates, these vibrations are transmitted to three small bones in the middle ear. These bones make the vibrations stronger and then pass them to a snail-shaped structure in the inner ear. Inside this fluid-filled structure are tiny hair cells. When the vibrations make waves in the fluid, the tiny hair cells move and generate electrical signals that travel to the auditory nerve. This nerve carries the information to the brain, where the signals are interpreted, allowing us to hear sound.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 음파가 귀를 통해 뇌에 도달하는 과정

det.korean: 이 글은 음파가 외이 → 외이도 → 고막 → 뼈 → 달팽이관 → 유모세포 → 청각신경 → 뇌의 경로를 설명한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ② 음파가 귀를 통해 뇌에 도달하는 과정: 전체 내용 요약. ❌ ① 소음 제거는 다른 단락. ❌ ③ 간섭은 다른 단락. ❌ ④ 유모세포는 부분에 불과.
det.tip: 주제 = 글 전체를 포괄하는 내용. 부분적 소재 ≠ 주제.

questions.passage: Which is the better environment for studying: a noisy place or a quiet place? Rarely do people want to put up with a lot of noise because it can be unpleasant and distracting. Fortunately, scientists have invented noise-cancelling technology, which is now being used across various fields to reduce unwanted noise. Noise-cancelling technology is not only used in music devices. Other fields also take advantage of this technology, such as ticket offices, drive-through restaurants, and cars. As technology advances, many people expect it will solve various social issues caused by noise pollution. Noise-cancellation technology can help address these problems by reducing unwanted disturbances, allowing people to lead more peaceful and healthier lives.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요약문으로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 소음 제거 기술은 다양한 분야에 적용되어 소음 문제를 해결하는 데 기여한다.
소음 제거 기술은 헤드폰에서만 효과적이며 다른 분야에서는 한계가 있다.
보강 간섭과 상쇄 간섭의 원리는 소리의 높낮이를 결정하는 핵심 요소이다.
귀의 유모세포는 진동을 전기 신호로 변환하여 뇌에 전달한다.

det.korean: 소음 제거 기술이 다양한 분야에서 활용되어 소음 문제를 해결한다는 것이 핵심.
det.analysis: ✅ ① 다양한 분야 적용 + 소음 문제 해결: 글 전체 요약. ❌ ② '헤드폰에서만' → not only. ❌ ③ 간섭 원리는 부분 주제. ❌ ④ 유모세포는 Deep Learning 단락의 부분.
det.tip: 요약 = 글의 핵심 메시지. 부분적 사실이 아닌 전체를 포괄.

questions.passage: Destructive interference is used in the noise-cancelling feature of headphones when we listen to music. Inside the headphones are microphones and noise-cancelling circuitry. The microphones pick up sounds from the outside, and the circuitry analyzes them to produce opposite sound waves.
questions.stem:
위 글을 참고하여 다음 문장을 완성하시오.

"헤드폰 안의 회로는 외부 소리를 분석하여 __________ sound waves를 만들어낸다."

(한 **영어** 단어로 쓸 것)

det.korean: 회로가 외부 소리를 분석하여 반대 음파를 생성한다.
det.analysis: ✅ opposite: 원문 'produce opposite sound waves'에서 확인.
det.tip: opposite sound waves = 반대 음파. 소음 제거의 핵심 원리.
